notes.title: NecroDancer Trick-or-Treat Versus Mode Available Now! - SYNCHRONY Update v3.2.0
notes.content:
[h2]BOO!!! 👻🎃🍬[/h2]

We have a treat for you all today... and no, it's not a trick! It's time for NecroDancer's first ever online seasonal event with the SYNCHRONY DLC's spooky new Trick-or-Treat versus mode!! Take on other players in a battle to collect the most candy from now until November 13!

This patch also introduces some other new additions to Versus mode--such as the multi-layered "Raveyard" zone, Vanish and Projection spells & tomes, a lobby level, a match summary screen and post-game replay--plus lots of other changes and fixes! Let's dig in.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2094810/Crypt_of_the_NecroDancer_SYNCHRONY/

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] Trick or Treat mode - a seasonal event for Versus Mode! (SYNCHRONY DLC required)
[list]
    [*] Enemies drop candy in addition to gold - collect the most candy across three rounds to win!
    [*] Players drop 50% of their held candy when defeated
    [*] Bosses drop a large candy bag upon being slain
    [*] Heal half a heart at any time by eating 10 pieces of candy
[/list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] "Raveyard" zone to Versus Mode
[list]
    [*] Fight under the full moon in this spooky, multi-layered arena!
[/list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] Vanish Spell to Versus Mode
[list]
    [*] Temporarily renders the caster invisible for 10 beats
    [*] Picking up items or attacking is not possible while invisible
    [*] Interacting with the world (digging, taking damage, etc.) ends the invisibility early
    [*] Greater version: lasts 20 beats instead
[/list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] Projection Spell to Versus Mode
[list]
    [*] Creates 3 decoy characters that mimic the caster's appearance and movements
    [*] Each decoy mimics the caster's movement at a different offset (90°, 180°, 270°)
    [*] Decoys disintegrate upon touching an obstacle, taking damage or after 8 beats
    [*] Greater version: spawns 7 decoys (4 of which move diagonally), lasts 16 beats instead, decoys phase through walls
[/list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] Vanish/Projection Tomes
[*] [b]Added[/b] a new lobby level to Versus Mode
[list]
    [*] Choose the game mode and level generation style using Shrines
    [*] Fight against players (or an unlimited supply of Skeletons) in a training arena
[/list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] match summary screen and post-game replay to Versus Mode
[*] [b]Added[/b] asset extraction tool to the resource pack menu
[list]
    [*] Creates a template from images and sounds associated with selected entities/tiles
    [*] Opens automatically when creating a new resource pack
    [*] Manually accessible by pressing 'Tab' on a local resource pack
[/list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] support for modifying procedural weapons (Onyx weapons, Tridents and modded weapons) in resource packs
[*] [b]Added[/b] integration for auto-installing and auto-updating subscribed mods via mod.io
[*] [b]Added[/b] a section to showcase the most popular mods when visiting the mod management menu
[*] [b]Added[/b] support for placing text labels in the level editor using Ctrl+F (prefix "@")
[*] [b]Added[/b] custom rule to control Selective Shopkeeper Retaliation
[*] [b]Added[/b] advanced option to prevent DLCs from automatically loading when launching the game
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Changed[/b] the sprite of Aria's/Coda's heart container
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Shrine of the Feast's activation condition
[list]
    [*] Overeating while standing next to the shrine drops between 1 and 4 items, depending on the amount overhealed
    [*] Previously, the shrine would require two food items to be eaten, dropping 3 items after the second consumption
[/list]
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Shrine of Fire to self-destruct its rewards if activated via an explosion
[list]
    [*] The shrine now only drops its Fireball Spell upon destruction if it was previously ignited by non-explosive means
[/list]
[*] [b]Changed[/b] trapdoors to transport dropped items to the next floor
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Electric Mages to only fire Electric Orbs at their target in multiplayer, instead of any aligned player
[*] [b]Changed[/b] players to respawn with a shovel after death in multiplayer
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Monk/Coda to fully remove gold piles in multiplayer after stepping into them
[*] [b]Changed[/b] minimap to always display the player's current segment in Versus Mode
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] shrines sometimes spawning items inside of walls
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] the Golden Lute not dealing piercing damage when thrown using the Throwing Charm
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Dorian not collecting gold on Cadence's final boss fight
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Berserk Spell causing softlocks on Melody's final boss fight
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Coral Riff not splashing at the correct intervals in Randomizer Mode
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] "8-ball" achievement unlocking when destroying trap rooms
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] enemies moving one beat sooner than usual when testing a level in the editor while a player skin is active
[/list]
[h3]Multiplayer bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Mary's lamb not being protected from other players' explosions if Friendly Fire is disabled
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] co-op leaderboards sometimes counting the number of players in a session incorrectly
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] music speeding up when returning to the lobby from post-game replay in multiplayer
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] music going out of sync in multiplayer when a high-latency player steps on a Tempo Trap
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] late-joining players not synchronizing their music time to the host when joining a paused session
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Wallpigs delaying their fireball inconsistently in multiplayer
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] damage immunity granted by exit stairs not always resetting correctly when switching levels in multiplayer
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] "Network issues detected" message showing briefly when the host pauses the game
[/list]
[h3]Versus Mode bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] players blinking when entering the lobby in Versus Mode
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] visual stutter when looping instant replays
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Monkeys and Tarmonsters being able to grab newly spawned players in Versus Mode
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] bosses always spawning at the map origin in Versus Mode
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Versus Mode event countdowns showing after the round ends
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] items and enemies sometimes despawning in Versus Mode lobby
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] players not colliding with each other in Versus Mode lobby practice room
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] stacked items not being picked up immediately in Versus Mode
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] song not looping in 'Last One Dancing' Versus Mode
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] quick restart not showing a confirmation prompt in Versus Mode
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Jade weapons not applying their poison effect on piercing attacks
[/list]
[h3]Menu bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] game not pausing if window focus is lost during a cutscene or level transition
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] disabled DLCs being re-enabled mid-run after loading a saved game
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] saved sessions with more than 2 local co-op players not resuming correctly at startup
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Pause menu appearing on top of cutscenes in single-player
[/list]
[h3]Modding bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] missed beats when looping Coral Riff's theme if the song is replaced by a resource pack
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Fortissimole rapping out of sync with the music when using a custom soundtrack
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] custom music file chooser failing to reopen after selecting a file name with special characters on Linux
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] mod translation generator failing to process some script file paths
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] error when a mod calls [i][noparse]inventory.dropSlot()[/noparse][/i] without passing a value for [i][noparse]keepItems[/noparse][/i]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] error when removing a script's last setting or snapshot variable while editing a mod
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] mod update checker not refreshing while in the lobby
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] procedural weapon graphics not reloading correctly when changing their parameters
[/list]
[h3]Visual bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] "Custom Mode" indicator being visible while the screen is fading out during a level transition
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] co-op HUD health bar displaying incorrectly on the Steam Deck
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Wallpigs facing the wrong way in the level editor's placement preview
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Obsidian Shield displaying incorrectly in Mystery Mode
[/list]

notes.title: SYNCHRONY Update v3.1.5
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We're back again with some changes and quite a few bug fixes, namely to improve multiplayer stability as well as fix a few issues surrounding leaderboards submissions! Thank you as usual for all of your feedback and be sure to keep an eye out for more fun content we have coming down the pike!

[list]

notes.title: Crypt of the NecroDancer v3.1.4 is now available!
notes.content:
Hey folks! It's been a bit, but we're back with another update for SYNCHRONY! As always, we'd love to hear your thoughts and feedback on these changes and additions. See you in the crypt!

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] Shrines to the "Extra Modes" room in the lobby
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6005263/b4ca5595ac748c279d1620e5a439e6d5bc40e519.png[/img]
[list]
	[*] Extra modes can now be toggled on or off by touching their corresponding shrines, allowing multiple modes to be active at once
	[*] The mode-specific staircases have been replaced by a single "Start run!" staircase, which begins an All Zones Mode Run with the chosen mode combination
	[*] Activating a shrine shows a brief description of the corresponding extra mode
	[*] In multiplayer, Extra Mode shrines are only usable by the host player
[/list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] run modifiers for multiplayer that do not affect leaderboards or achievements:
[list]
	[*] [i]Character Lock[/i]: forces all players to use the host's chosen character
	[*] [i]Low Percent[/i]: Kills any players attempting to pick up an item or activate a shrine
	[*] [i]Friendly Fire[/i]: Toggles the ability for bombs to hurt other players
[/list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] visual extra mode indicators in the lobby, showing which modes are currently enabled
[*] [b]Added[/b] experimental cross-platform online multiplayer between Steam and GOG
[list]
	[*] Players from both platforms can join each other's lobbies and play together without the need for port forwarding
[/list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] a confirmation menu when quick restarting a multiplayer run after the first level
[*] [b]Added[/b] an option to change the title of an ongoing multiplayer lobby using the "Lobby settings" menu
[*] [b]Added[/b] an option to mute the boss intro announcer
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[h3]Characters[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Suzu's supercharge to collect gold piles when dashing over them
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Bolt's unlock condition from "Complete the game with Monk" to "Complete All Zones mode"
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Dove to no longer encounter Wall Spikes
[*] [b]Changed[/b] possessed Shopkeepers to pay gold coins for every attack
[*] [b]Changed[/b] attack sound effect of possessed Banshees to reduce loudness
[*] [b]Changed[/b] possessed enemy health bars to measure health in half-heart units, matching regular player characters
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Shrine of Duplication's Mannequin to no longer drop gold for Monk and Coda
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Monk and Coda to leave behind a single coin when jumping into a gold pile in multiplayer
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Double Tempo Mode to submit to separate leaderboards on Coda
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Nocturna's story boss fights to let the view follow the local player in online sessions
[/list]
[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Changed[/b] the Shopkeeper to only chase after attackers (and shoplifters) in multiplayer
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Low% state to be preserved when retrieving items stolen by the Thief
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Thief's spawn sound to be audible when playing with a low sound volume and a high music volume
[/list]
[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Berserk Spell to grant extra beats of invincibility upon casting and after ending
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Shield of Shove to be unbreakable while shoving
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Onyx weapons to appear less often in boss reward chests
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Onyx weapon shop prices:
[list]
	[*] Lowered costs of Onyx Dagger, Broadsword, Whip and Spear
	[*] Increased costs of Onyx Bow, Crossbow, Cutlass and Warhammer
[/list]
[*] [b]Changed[/b] Throwing Charm to interact uniquely with loaded Crossbows
[*] [b]Changed[/b] player-placed bombs to no longer hurt other players in the Synchrony DLC
[/list]
[h3]Level editor[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Changed[/b] dungeons created in the level editor to also save their set of Custom Rules
[*] [b]Changed[/b] level editor to automatically join in-progress test runs of other players
[/list]
[h3]Engine changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Changed[/b] music timing logic to improve input reliability, error handling and multiplayer synchronization
[*] [b]Changed[/b] weapon attack swipes to follow player movement smoothly
[*] [b]Changed[/b] translations for all supported languages
[*] [b]Changed[/b] player health bars to be hidden in the lobby
[*] [b]Changed[/b] "Reassign controls" menu to indicate which bindings are automatically managed by Steam Input
[*] [b]Changed[/b] "Quick lobby movement" setting to be overridable by the host player
[*] [b]Changed[/b] leaderboard submissions to be skipped for players who stay in spectator mode for more than half of the run
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[h3]Performance bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] performance issues and crashes on Apple M1/Silicon Macs
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] lag spikes when toggling Randomizer Mode, Mystery Mode or Dancepad Mode on/off
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] low framerate in the lobby in large multiplayer sessions
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] low framerate in the lobby when accumulating large piles of thrown weapons
[/list]
[h3]Multiplayer bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] black screen when a player leaves during a level transition in multiplayer
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] non-host players missing the menu option to return to the lobby's main room
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] custom skins not being displayed in the late-join character selection menu
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] softlock in multiplayer when the last player on the floor disconnects
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] "Freeze Frame" effects causing flickering graphics in multiplayer
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] configuration menu not allowing settings to be edited online
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] viewport position not instantly updating when late-joining online sessions
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] idle character being left behind when a player leaves during a cutscene in multiplayer
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] cutscenes continuing to play when disconnecting from an online game
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] level music sometimes playing during cutscenes in multiplayer
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] All-Chars/Story runs sometimes ending prematurely in multiplayer
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] All-Chars/Story Mode causing spectators or disconnected players to respawn in multiplayer
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] minimap vision range not being consistent between single-player and multiplayer
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] other players not showing on the minimap from within the secret shop
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] animations sometimes getting stuck when entering a new level in multiplayer
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] snapshot synchronization taking too long when using direct IP connections
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] custom skins not loading after character switches in All-Chars/Story runs
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Shopkeepers not being scared of the Fear Scroll
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] enemies sometimes moving immediately after being summoned by a boss
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] more enemies generating than intended for Dove
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Thief being able to steal Mary's Lamb and deployed familiars
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Berserk not protecting some glass items
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] the player's last remaining heart container being removed when dropping Ring of Peace
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] crates being immune to bombs while unrevealed
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Shrine of Binding not linking holstered weapons
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Shrine of Binding not linking item conversions via shrines
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Shrine of Binding causing items to drop in the wrong location
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Shrine of War converting Shock Monkeys to White Monkeys
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] generated shrines not falling back to Shrine of Glass when the shrine pool is depleted
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Chaunter not breaking Low Percent when using a shrine during possession
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Chaunter ignoring item restrictions when transferring its inventory to a possession target
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Gigantism granting immunity to Hot Coals
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] awoken Gargoyles not taking damage while frozen
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] error when an unrevealed crate is pushed down a trapdoor
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Rifle dealing incorrect damage when thrown with the Throwing Charm
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Throwing Charm sometimes being consumed without performing a return throw
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Super Secret Shopkeeper not being centered when spawning above a food shop
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] spirits spawning on unrevealed tiles
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] potential errors when killing a Warlock during possession while holding a Ring of Courage
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] enemies not always struggling against possessed or charmed monkeys
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] possessed enemies not receiving a dig bonus from Gigantism
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] possessed enemies stopping when berserking into other enemies
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] softlock when the time runs out on Melody's final boss fight
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Melody's Golden Lute throws not damaging her final boss
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] price tags not being removed when buying a duplicate charm
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] enemy splash attacks not being affected by damage-boosting items
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] missing alternate voice lines for Mary's greetings, attacks and cheers
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Shock Monkeys and other electric attacks not hitting Electric Zombies
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] players being able to rapidly use items or spells on ice
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Blast Helm explosions not being instant while sliding on ice
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Coda encountering Ooze Golems when the AMPLIFIED DLC is disabled
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Merlin not offering Ring of Phasing if AMPLIFIED DLC is disabled
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Hephaestus not offering Warhammer, Heavy Glass Armor, Holster or Hargreaves
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Aria starting Dancepad Mode in Zone 1
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] seed variance for button trap locations in Cadence's final boss
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] unprovoked Shopkeepers being targeted by charmed enemies
[/list]
[h3]Achievement/leaderboard bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] pre-3.0 Hard/No-Return Mode clears not counting towards "Mode Master" achievement
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] multi-character achievements not auto-unlocking when a corresponding leaderboard entry is present
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] All Zones completion achievements not unlocking in All-Chars/Story Mode
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] "Custom Mode" menu ignoring unlock condition for All Characters Mode
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] progression unlocks and achievements being awarded to spectators
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] some statistics (e.g. Green Bat Kills) not counting correctly across Save & Quit
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] debug commands not disabling leaderboards for non-host players in multiplayer
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Randomizer All-Chars/Story Mode runs cross-submitting to All Zones leaderboards, despite using the same seed each loop
[/list]
[h3]Controller bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] missing controller bindings for switching pages in the mod menu or leaving spectator mode
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] game exiting on title screen when pressing B on a controller
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] incorrect controller prompts for "Join game", "Next page" and "Previous page"
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] first column in "Reassign controls" being overwritten with Steam Input disabled
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Player 1 not always automatically switching to controller input at startup
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Steam Input failing to initialize if no controller is plugged in when launching the game
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] "Diagonal" Steam Input action set layer not being applied correctly in local co-op
[/list]
[h3]Editor bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] newly loaded levels in the online level editor not being visible until host enters the room
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] level editor sometimes momentarily displaying the spectator mode HUD in multiplayer
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] level editor not switching to the next level when immediately deleting the first level after opening a dungeon
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] level editor not switching to the next level when the current level is deleted in multiplayer
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] level editor level list selection going out of bounds
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] level editor sometimes reloading all mods when switching between levels in multiplayer
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] error in the level editor when clearing the selection box while quick-dragging a section of the level
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] error in the level editor when deleting the first level while an online player is connecting
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] error when loading a dungeon in the editor while online players are in a test run
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] level editor not sending all online players back to lobby when the host leaves the editor
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] "Restore default gameplay" appearing in level editor play rooms
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] spirits not appearing when spawned via the in-game editor
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] custom dungeon level options (e.g. "No Items", "Low Health") not applying to late-joiners
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] entity attribute modifications in level editor not always applying correctly
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Charm Spell not showing up in level editor
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] players getting stuck in editor test runs if the host deletes the level being tested
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Moles not being movable into obstacles in the level editor
[/list]
[h3]Other engine bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] errors when resuming a session that was saved in a previous version of the game
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] the player sometimes entering spectator mode when resuming a saved session
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] music timing drift when switching between characters with different soundtracks in the lobby
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] audio device errors sometimes causing beat bars and the in-game timer to run backwards
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] framerate limit option allowing redundant "VSync" value
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] custom music menu not reporting an error when failing to load a song
[/list]
[h3]Visual bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] clones appearing as Cadence's instead of Chaunter's when entering a level while possessing an enemy
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Dash Spell's visual tell taking too long to show up
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Greater Dash Spell's visual tell not accounting for the extra range
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] characters appearing below walls in Phasing Mode when wearing Winged Boots
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Pawnbroker price previews ignoring item slot restrictions
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Danganronpa skins being offset incorrectly
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] character sprites displaying at incorrect offsets in the skin selection menu
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] visual bugs when using a Shrine of Glass while holding an Obsidian Weapon
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Nicolas Daoust being selectable without the AMPLIFIED DLC, turning the Shopkeeper into a white square that does not sing
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] numerous "Beat Skipped" flyaways showing up when playing Bolt in Double Tempo Mode
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Dorian visually equipping Cadence's spells in the final boss fight
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] gold counter in the HUD getting squished more than necessary
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] speedrun timer getting squished in some languages
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] some enemy health bars not being aligned to the tile grid
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] certain resolutions and view multipliers causing lobby text to jitter
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] inconsistent visuals when changing "Character Lock" setting via lobby shrine
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] offset for one of Suzu's armor sprites
[/list]
[h2]Modding[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] support for loading custom TTF/OTF fonts in resource packs
[list]
	[*] Font replacements for the non-pixel font are loaded from [i][noparse]<Resource Pack Name>/ttf/NotoSansJP-Bolt.otf[/noparse][/i]
	[*] "Enable pixel font" in the Language Options must be unchecked for this font replacement to take effect
	[*] To force a full font reload when activating the resource pack, create a text file containing [i][noparse]Key,Text[/noparse][/i] and save it as [i][noparse]<Resource Pack Name>/languages/all.csv[/noparse][/i]
[/list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] event [i][noparse]clientRequestRestart[/noparse][/i] to handle quick restarts from the hotkey or the pause menu
[*] [b]Added[/b] event [i][noparse]itemGenerate[/noparse][/i] to allow mods to intercept item generation
[*] [b]Added[/b] component [i][noparse]itemCommon[/noparse][/i] which marks "regular" items, distinguishing them from internal items like deployed familiars
[*] [b]Added[/b] component [i][noparse]playableCharacterNonSelectable[/noparse][/i] to exclude characters from the lobby
[*] [b]Added[/b] command line option [i][noparse]--no-load[/noparse][/i] to discard saved sessions
[*] [b]Added[/b] debug command [i][noparse]translateMods()[/noparse][/i] to generate a translation template for all loaded mods
[*] [b]Added[/b] an option to show internal entity names in the level editor
[/list][list]
[*] [b]Changed[/b] events [i][noparse]objectTakeDamage[/noparse][/i]/[i][noparse]holderTakeDamage[/noparse][/i] to always supply [i][noparse]ev.attacker[/noparse][/i], using an empty table for environmental damage

notes.title: NecroDancer SYNCHRONY DLC Available Now! - Update v3.1.0
notes.content:
[h2]RE-ANIMATE!!![/h2]

The Crypt has been silent for 5 years, but now the NecroDancer is back from the dead with a huge new DLC! SYNCHRONY adds online multiplayer (co-op and vs), three new characters, full mod support (& built-in mod portal), new items, enemies, & more! Let's take a look!

[previewyoutube=MX9JlggiCHo;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2094810/Crypt_of_the_NecroDancer_SYNCHRONY/

[h1]New DLC - Crypt of the NecroDancer: SYNCHRONY![/h1]

[h2]New Characters[/h2]
[h3]Klarinetta[/h3]
[list][*] Wields the Zweihänder, a heavy sword that occupies a tile diagonally adjacent to her.
[*] The Zweihänder follows Klarinetta's movement, striking any enemies in its way.
[*] Diagonal movement buttons swing the Zweihänder around in a quarter-circle or half-circle, attacking enemies on several tiles at once.
[list][*] Rotating the sword takes a full beat and causes Klarinetta to stand still momentarily.[/list]
[*] When held in place, the Zweihänder acts as a barrier against enemies, preventing them from walking into the tile it occupies.
[/list]
[h3]Chaunter[/h3]
[list][*] A frail, ghostly being who with only half a heart, which cannot be increased by any means.
[*] Wields the Lantern, which has the range of a dagger and provides a small amount of light.
[*] Striking enemies with the Lantern gradually takes over their soul, allowing Chaunter to possess them after dealing enough damage!
[*] Possessing an enemy lets Chaunter take full control, copying their health, damage and abilities
[*] All enemy abilities are mapped to the action and spell slots.
[list][*] For example, a possessed Red Dragon breathes fire using the two spell buttons.[/list]
[*] Slow enemies such as Skeletons or Golems can move quickly while possessed.
[list][*] Unlike fast enemies or Chaunter itself, slow enemies are allowed to wield weapons, overriding their usual attack!
[*] Attacking, digging or using items forces them to stand still for a few beats.[/list]
[*] When losing all hearts while transformed into an enemy, Chaunter reverts back to its usual form.
[*] Control of an enemy cannot be kept indefinitely - a countdown of 24 beats starts ticking as soon as Chaunter takes possession.
[list][*] Once the timer runs out, the possessed enemy starts taking damage, eventually forcing Chaunter back into its base form.
[*] This can also be done manually by performing the 'Eject' action ([i]Left+Right[/i]).[/list][/list]
[h3]Suzu[/h3]
[list][*] Wields the Lance of Courage, a melee weapon that unleashes a rapid, powerful dash when killing an enemy!
[list]
[*] All enemies in a straight line are killed instantly as Suzu dashes through them.
[*] The dash attack is only stopped by walls and shielded enemies, letting Suzu travel many tiles in an instant.
[*] Bounce traps redirect her dash, altering her attack trajectory and final position!
[*] Suzu is fully invincible during her dash, protecting her from any enemies waiting at her destiation.
[/list][/list]
[h2]Online Multiplayer[/h2]
Play with [b]up to 8 players[/b] at once in online co-op and versus modes!

[h3]Rollback Multiplayer Architecture[/h3]
[list]
[*] Play with friends from around the world without perceptible input/audio/visual lag!
[*] High-latency support: two-player sessions are playable up to 300 milliseconds of latency.
[/list]
[h3]In-game lobby browser and lobby visibility settings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Includes public, friends-only, and private lobbies
[*] Steam multiplayer integration for creating and joining lobbies - no port forwarding needed.
[*] Optional support for direct IP connections and LAN play.
[*] Headless dedicated server to allow hosting persistent lobbies and tournament matches.
[/list]
[h3]Spectator Mode[/h3]
[list][*] Spectate any individual player, changing targets at any time.
[*] 'Spectate everyone' mode, splitting the HUD and zooming out the game view to see all players at once.
[*] Automatic spectator view upon death or after entering stairs while waiting for other players to finish the level.
[*] Ability to return to the level after entering the stairs to rejoin players instead of waiting.
[/list]
[h3]Late joining and rejoining support for online sessions[/h3]
[list][*] Disconnecting automatically enters spectator mode, allowing the player to jump back into the game after reconnecting.
[*] Health bars and name plates for other players in online sessions and spectator mode.
[*] In-game text chat with various scaling and visibility options.
[*] Seamless hosting: an ongoing run can be opened up into a multiplayer session at any time via the 'Host online game' menu option.
[list][*] Multiplayer save & quit restored sessions can be re-opened to the network, allowing other players to rejoin.
[/list]
[*] Replays and cutscenes can be watched together online, with the host player having access to the playback controls.
[*] Per-player resource packs (Workshop mods):
[list][*] Each player can load their own individual set of resource packs, independently of the host or other players.
[*] The player character's appearance can be customized freely by choosing skins from any installed mod.
[*] Support for custom beatmaps can be enabled by the host player, allowing players to move at different speeds.[/list][/list]
[h3]Hybrid online and local co-op support[/h3]
[list][*] Up to 4 local players can play together, including in online sessions.[/list]
[h3]DLC Cross-Play Support[/h3]
[list][*] DLC-only modes, characters, items, enemies and Zone 5 are disabled while the DLC is inactive.
[*] Players without the AMPLIFIED DLC can connect to lobbies hosted in non-AMPLIFIED mode.
[*] AMPLIFIED players can join non-AMPLIFIED lobbies, automatically turning off DLC content in the process.
[*] Online multiplayer is available to all owners of the Synchrony DLC, even if the new gameplay content is disabled.
[*] Cross-platform multiplayer between Windows, macOS and Linux.
[*] Networking performance features:
[list][*] Desync detection, automatically resynchronizing players in case of a game state difference.
[*] Dynamic input reprioritization, limiting the impact of any one player's lag spikes on other players in the session.
[*] Hybrid peer-to-peer and server-client network code, reducing latency in cross-region multiplayer sessions.
[*] Noise control system to gradually lower the volume of any repetitive player-made sounds.
[/list][/list]
[h2]New Items[/h2]
[h3]Shield Slot[/h3]
[list][*]Faces in the wielder's movement direction and protects them against damage from that direction.
[*] [b]Wooden Shield[/b]: Protects against one hit before breaking.
[*] [b]Titanium Shield[/b]: Protects against two hits before breaking.
[*] [b]Heavy Shield[/b]: Protects against three hits before breaking, and also grants knockback immunity while active.
[*] [b]Obsidian Shield[/b]: Shields 1, 2 or 3 hits depending on the wielder's coin multiplier.
[*] [b]Shield of Strength[/b]: Protects against one hit before breaking. Grants +1 damage while unbroken!
[*] [b]Reflective Shield[/b]: Protects against one hit before breaking, deflecting damage back to the enemy in the process.
[*] [b]Shield of Shove[/b]: Protects against one hit before breaking, and allows the wielder to shove adjacent enemies.[/list]
[h3]Onyx Weapons[/h3]
[list][*] Deals greatly increased damage on consecutive hits, but loses the damage bonus upon moving.
[*] Most effective on weapons that hit a broad range of tiles, less so on weapons with dash attacks[/list]
[h3]Trident[/h3]
[list][*] Attacks like a broadsword at a higher range, hitting a row of three tiles, or like a dagger at close range.
[*] Comes in all common weapon flavors: Basic, Blood, Gold, Titanium, Glass, Obsidian and Onyx!
[*] Throwable! When thrown, three lanes are hit at once instead of just one, clearing out a much wider area![/list]
[h3]Throwing Charm[/h3]
[list][*] Allows [i]any[/i] weapon to be thrown like a Dagger!
[*] Once per level: throwing a weapon causes it to return to the wielder, dealing damage on the way back.
[*] Stepping sideways after throwing slants the return trajectory, allowing different tiles to be hit!
[/list]
[h3]Berserk Spell[/h3]
[list][*] Starts a berserking charge on the next move, killing any enemies unfortunate enough to stand in the way!
[*] Stops upon colliding with a wall or any other obstacle.
[*] The Berserk state grants immunity to incoming attacks, but removes the ability to change directions until it ends.
[*] Greater Berserk fills the caster with even more blind rage, additionally killing enemies on adjacent tiles![/list]
[h3]Dash Spell[/h3]
[list][*] Turns the next move into a long-range dashing attack, dealing 4 hearts of damage to any enemies along its path!
[*] If an enemy is killed by the dash, the caster will pass right through.
[*] Greater Dash increases the range and damage of the dashing attack!
[/list]
[h3]Charm Spell[/h3]
[list][*] Charm nearby monsters to turn them into temporary allies!
[*] Allied monsters will seek out and attack other enemies until the effect wears off.
[*] Bumping into an allied monster pushes it out of the way, dealing damage when squished against an obstacle.
[*] Greater Charm's effect does not wear off, turning monsters into allies for the entire duration of the floor![/list]
[h3]Scroll of Duplication[/h3]
[list][*] Drops from an activated Shrine of Duplication.
[*] Duplicates all items, enemies, crates and chests in 3x3 range around the user.
[*] Enemies, crates and chests are only duplicated if there is space behind them.
[*] Shop items retain their price tags when duplicated.
[*] The Scroll of Duplication itself cannot be duplicated.
[/list]
[h2]New Enemies[/h2]
[h3]Thief[/h3]
[list][*] Runs towards the player and tries to steal their items! Weapons and items in locked slots are not stolen.
[*] In co-op mode, the Thief takes turns trying to rob different players, and will dodge attacks from any player other than its target.
[*] When two items are stolen successfully, the Thief laughs at their victims and quickly disappears.
[*] When killed, it drops a random uncommon item, along with any potentially stolen goods.
[*] The Thief has a low chance of spawning on any level but is slightly more common in co-op mode[/list]
[h3]Mannequin[/h3]
[list][*] Created by the Shrine of Duplication - copies all equipment of the player who activates the shrine.
[*] Mirrors the actions the player closest to it - movement, attacks, digging and even using items and spells!
[*] Can pick up items and gold from the ground, which are dropped upon death.
[/list]
[h3]Shock Monkey[/h3]
[list][*] While grabbed, deals half a heart of damage to its struggling victim per hit!
[*] Each hit also starts an electric arc that damages nearby enemies.
[*] Stay away from water![/list]
Stay tuned for more enemies to come during Early Access!
[h2]New Traps[/h2]
[h3]Dice Trap[/h3]
[list][*] When stepped on, the Dice Trap spawns a number of completely random enemies from any zone, then disappears.[/list]
[h3]Automatic Spike Trap[/h3]
[list][*] Alternates between extending and retracting each beat. Inflicts damage only while extended.
[/list]
[h3]Floor Crack[/h3]
[list]
[*] Guaranteed to spawn exactly once per zone, somewhere on a random level.
[*] Creates a trapdoor upon being destroyed by a bomb.
[/list]
[h3]Spiked Wall[/h3]
[list]
[*] Inflicts damage to the player when dug with a shovel.
[*] Spikes are only visible if the corresponding side of the wall is adjacent to a floor tile.
[*] Revealed enemies take damage when moving into spiked wall tiles.
[/list]
[h2]New Shrines[/h2]
[h3]Shrine of Duplication[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spawns a Mannequin wielding copies of all items worn by the player who triggered the shrine.
[*] The Mannequin mirrors [i]all[/i] actions of the closest player!
[*] Defeating the Mannequin will drop its items on the ground, granting a duplicate set of items for other players to pick up.
[*] Can only be found in co-op mode.
[/list]
[h3]Shrine of Binding[/h3]
[list]
[*] When touched by two players at once, their souls are linked together for the rest of the run.
[*] Linked players share one and the same inventory, health bar and coin multiplier.
[*] If one player takes damage or dies, both players are affected!
[*] In online multiplayer, linked players can always see each other, with the view expanding as needed to fit both players.
[*] Can only be found in co-op mode.
[/list]
[h3]Shrine of the Feast[/h3]
[list]
[*] Activates upon eating two food items adjacent to the shrine, granting a choice between three items.
[*] Cannot be interacted with directly.
[/list]
[h3]Shrine of Fire[/h3]
[list]
[*] Activates upon inflicting fire-type damage to the shrine, granting a choice between three items.
[*] Cannot be interacted with directly.
[/list]
[h2]Other Gameplay Features[/h2]
[h3]Pawnbroker Rework[/h3]
[list]
[*] After two items have been sold to him, the Pawnbroker will present a selection of his finest wares at great prices!
[*] He offers a choice between three items at a discount, of which only one can be chosen.
[*] Selling more items causes him to re-roll his shop's contents, presenting a different choice of three items.
[*] After purchasing an item, selling more equipment will not cause the shop items to reappear.
[*] Selling enough items causes the Pawnbroker to present his Special Offer!
[/list]
[h3]Equipment Sprites[/h3]
[list][*] Displays all held and equipped items on the player character's sprite.
[*] The visibility of equipment sprites can be controlled in the 'Change Skin' menu.
[*] By default, equipment sprites are only visible on the default skin, and hidden when selecting a custom skin.
[/list]
[h2]New Game Modes[/h2]
[h3]Versus Modes[/h3]
[list][b]Engage in combat with other players in Player versus Player modes![/b]
[*]Instead of going through the floors of the crypt together, use various items and strategies to defeat your opponents!
[*]Arenas are procedurally generated, combining 2 zones into 1 floor!
[*]As the game progresses, various events can happen on the arena. This includes shop travel runes spawning, everyone becoming confused, and... telemonkeys?!
[/list]
[h3]Versus mode: Deathmatch (default)[/h3]
[list][*]In this mode, the winner is the player who manages to get the most points, which are earned by defeating others.
[*]Getting defeated by taking damage from enemies or floor hazards results is penalized by losing one point.
[*]However, if the above happens shortly after taking damage from a player, that player will be considered the killer. In this case, there's no penalty and the other player gains a point normally.
[*]Players respawn shortly after being defeated, so you can get back to the action quickly!
[*]To view the list of players and their points, use the 'Toggle player list' hotkey ('Tab' by default, configurable in menu controls).
[*]By default, a deathmatch consists of 3 rounds on different floors. However, this (and many other things) can be changed in the 'Custom rules' menu after entering Versus Mode!
[/list]
[h3]Versus mode: Last One Dancing[/h3]
[list][*]The winner is simply the player who manages to survive the longest - no complicated rules here!
[*]To enable this mode, change the game mode in the 'Custom rules' menu.
[/list]
[h3]Team Up With Other Players[/h3]
[list]
[*]The modes above can also be played in teams, which can be enabled within 'Custom rules'!
[*]Players can either be assigned to teams automatically or choose their teams manually.
[/list]
[h3]Use never-before-seen items, which appear exclusively in Versus[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Wind Tomes[/b]: push away nearby enemies and players! It may also be used to surprise your opponents with bombs...
[*][b]Goblin Bomber Charm[/b]: makes you drop a lit bomb when defeated.
[*][b]Ring of Gluttony[/b]: makes food heal you a bit more.
[*][b]Ring of Whirlwind[/b]: casts a greater wind spell which pushes enemies away when you get hit and also prevents the damage, then shatters.
[*][b]Essences[/b]: these mysterious items allow you to enchant your weapon to a specific material!
[*][b]Electricity Tomes[/b]: temporarily grants electric attack powers ([i]note[/i]: this item will only appear if the AMPLIFIED DLC is enabled)
[/list]
[h3]Versus-Specific Item Tweaks[/h3]
[list][*] Certain changes have been made to some items to make them work better in PvP. These changes are [b]only applied when in versus mode[/b], and the items function as normal outside of it.
[list]
[*][b]Cookies[/b]: to prevent excessive invincibility frames, their base quantity has been lowered to 3.
[*][b]Fireball Spell/Tome/Scroll[/b]: limited the range to 3 tiles and reduced damage to 2 and 4 for normal fireball and greater fireball respectively. However, the 2-damage version can still be used to open crates.
[*][b]Pulse Spell/Tome/Scroll[/b]: reduced damage to 2 and 4 for normal pulse and greater pulse respectively, and similar to fireball, the 2-damage version can still open crates. Pulse now also bypasses shields and armor.
[*][b]Freeze Spell/Tome/Scroll[/b]: duration of freezes has been halved.
[*][b]Shield Spell/Tome/Scroll[/b]: duration of shields has been halved.
[*][b]Various Spells[/b] also received adjustments to their cooldowns and blood cast costs.
[*][b]Grenade Charm[/b]: the damage buff has been removed, making grenades deal the same damage as regular bombs.
[*][b]Ring of Regeneration[/b]: heals 0.5 hearts every 50 beats.
[*][b]Ring of Peace[/b]: makes you invisible to enemies (but not other players).
[*][b]Arc Dagger[/b]: replaced the infinite damage when standing on a wire with a +2 damage boost.
[*][b]Rifle/Blunderbuss[/b]: piercing effect has been removed, Rifle's range is now limited to 4 tiles.
[*][b]Rapiers[/b]: when lunging, damage is increased by 1 instead of being doubled.
[*][b]Battle Shovel[/b]: replaced the infinite damage after digging with a +2 damage boost.
[*][b]Crown of Thorns[/b]: heals every 5 kills, removed damage on pickup.
[*][b]Throwing Charm[/b]: the effect of making thrown weapons return is restored after 50 beats.
[/list]
[h3]New Weapon Material: Jade[/h3]
[list]
[*]Use jade weapons to apply poison to the target of your attack!
[*]After becoming poisoned, characters will take damage after 3 beats. This damage cannot be avoided by normal means.
[*]However, poison can be healed by consuming food, preventing the damage from happening entirely.
[*]Use Jade Essence to enchant your weapon to a jade version.
[/list]
[h3]New Weapon Material: Crimson[/h3]:
[list]
[*]Crimson weapons heal the user every 5 kills. However, unlike blood weapons, they do not grant a damage boost when on low health.
[*]They are also piercing by default, bypassing any armor and shields your opponents may have!
[*]Use Crimson Essence to enchant your weapon to a crimson version.
[/list]
[h3]Other Mechanics[/h3]
[list]
[*]When multiple players perform actions on the same beat, they are resolved in the following order:
[list]
[*]item/spell usage
[*]weapon attacks
[*]movement
[/list]
[*]This means that you are always able to use a defensive item before getting hit. However, when you are in someone's range, they will be able to hit you even if you try to move away!
[*]When transmogrifying a weapon in Versus, it will keep its current material.[/list]
[h2]Balance Tweaks[/h2]
Alongside a few quality-of-life changes, many of these tweaks are aimed at improving the game's balance for speedrun and races, while not affecting casual runs too significantly. All of these changes take effect when the Synchrony DLC is enabled:

[list][*] Removed Boots of Lunging, Magic Cookies and Charm of Strength from crates.
[*] Removed food items from Shrine of Pain's reward item pool.
[*] Removed Blood Dagger from Shrine of Blood's item pool.
[*] Removed Scrolls from boss reward chests.
[*] Reduced the number of doorway-blocking Green Slimes on Monk/Coda.
[*] Reduced chance of crates containing Boots of Leaping and Ring of Pain.
[*] Reduced the number of enemies removed by Ring of Peace from 8 to 5.
[*] Changed Shrine of Darkness to increase the tracking distance of enemies from 3 to 5 tiles.
[*] Changed Mary's Curse to no longer bypass the Potion.
[*] Increased the base price of the Map from 25 to 75.
[*] Increased the base price of the Compass from 6 to 25.
[*] Increased the base price of the Torch of Walls from 20 to 50.
[*] Increased minimum spawning distance for enemies summoned by Nocturna's final boss from 2 to 3 tiles.
[*] Increased the minimum distance for Skeletons summoned by Death Metal 1 and 2 from 2 to 2.5 tiles.
[*] Changed Shrine of Glass to convert Heavy Plate Armor into Heavy Glass Armor.
[*] Changed Shrine of Glass to no longer grant Glass Jaw to Melody, Eli or Tempo.
[*] Reduced the number of trapdoors appearing in levels, particularly near the spawn point.
[*] Reduced the maximum number of Skeletons summoned by Death Metal 1 from 3 to 2.
[*] Reduced the number of upgraded Tentacles in Coral Riff by 2 per zone.
[*] Reduced the spawn limit of Nocturna's final boss from 24 to 16 in single-player (unchanged in co-op).
[*] Reduced the health of the batteries in phase 2 of Nocturna's final boss fight from 8 to 6.
[*] Changed the batteries of Nocturna's final boss to be immune to the player's bombs.
[*] Reduced the priority of Electric Orbs to be slightly above barrels, but below all other enemies.
[*] Changed players to no longer collide with each other or block thrown weapons in co-op mode.
[*] Changed co-op mode to require all players to finish the level to proceed to the next floor (with at least one player making it to the exit alive).
[/list]

Throughout Early Access, we intend to make further adjustments and changes to these tweaks based on your feedback! We look forward to hearing your thoughts on these changes!

[h2]Modding Features[/h2]
[h3]Full mod support via an extensive Lua modding API[/h3]
[list]
[*] Event-driven game code, allowing most gameplay events to be intercepted and handled by mods.
[*] Full live-reloading: mods can be edited and the changes seen in real-time.
[list]
[*] Mods can be loaded and unloaded in the middle of a run.
[/list]
[*] Ability to load multiple Lua mods at the same time.
[*] Automatic multiplayer compatibility for most (deterministic) gameplay mods.
[*] Flexible Entity-Component-System architecture, allowing for the extension and modification of all entities in the game.
[*] Customization points for tiles, level generation and other gameplay systems.
[list]
[*] Procedural weapon system to define new weapon materials and shapes and have their combinations generated automatically.
[*] Customizable item pools for shops, secret rooms, chests and crates.
[/list]
[*] API reference webpage, listing functions, components, events and classes with descriptions where available.[/list]
[h3]Mod Portal for sharing and discovering community-made mods, powered by mod.io![/h3]
[list][*] In-game menu to manage, browse and download gameplay mods.
[*] Auto-download mods (after a confirmation prompt) when joining a server with mods that are not locally installed.
[*] Auto-update system for mods, informing the user on the main menu when a new version of an installed mod is available.
[*] Options for mod categorization (favorite/hidden, local/downloaded, active/inactive) and filtering.
[*] mod.io upload integration: publish mods directly via the in-game mod menu!
[list]
[*] mod.io account creation is not required to browse, download and play mods.
[*] A log-in via Steam or an e-mail code is only prompted when publishing a mod.
[/list][/list]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added leaderboards for No-Beat Mode, tracked separately from the Custom Music leaderboards
[*] Added leaderboards for Bolt Double Tempo Mode
[*] Added separate highscore leaderboards for the Gold Duplication exploit
[/list]
[h2]Quirks[/h2]
The following Quirks that were retained for compatibility with previous versions are now fixed when the Synchrony DLC is enabled:
[list][*] Fixed Aria and Coda encountering empty barrels in Zone 4 when a barrel would have contained a monkey
[*] Fixed Armadillo shields being bypassed by double attacks in co-op mode or via 'Pain' items
[*] Fixed players not dash-attacking into Electric Orbs unless wielding a Rapier
[*] Fixed Backpacks containing one item sometimes requiring the secondary key combination to be pressed to activate the item
[*] Fixed explosions causing enemies to act one beat sooner
[*] Fixed boss fights being skippable by using Earth Spell just below the main arena
[*] Fixed Pack of Holding not dropping its contents when switching to a regular Backpack
[*] Fixed gold coins being duplicated if picked up while merging with another gold pile (can be re-enabled to submit to "Duping" leaderboards)
[*] Fixed Skeleton Knights sometimes taking double knockback when dismounted
[*] Fixed Waterballs not causing the player to sink into the water if they had previously unsunken themselves on the same tile
[*] Fixed Earth Spell not creating walls on final story bosses
[*] Fixed Exploding Mushroom and Pixies being able to damage unrevealed enemies
[*] Fixed Familiars becoming displaced from the player character when a Warlock is killed via Boots of Pain
[*] Fixed Nocturna's penultimate boss being able to telefrag himself, sometimes skipping a phase of the boss fight
[*] Fixed Heavy Glass Armor being stackable past 3 stacks
[*] Fixed Boots of Leaping and Boots of Lunging sharing the same toggle state when switching between them
[*] Fixed Boots of Leaping not stopping in front of walls in Phasing Mode
[*] Fixed Boots of Lunging allowing Shopkeepers and story boss props to be knocked back
[*] Fixed Aria's final boss being taking damage from non-weapon sources while confused
[*] Fixed Shovemonsters and Gorgons not moving past Mary's lamb
[*] Fixed Metrognomes teleporting to the exit stairs instead of the their spawn point
[*] Fixed Mystery Mode not obscuring the player's shovel swipe
[*] Fixed healing not granting invincibility frames on Cadence's final boss fight
[*] Fixed Melody's final boss sometimes standing still near walls
[*] Fixed Nightmare shadows causing enemies to act one beat sooner after being revealed
[*] Fixed Eli's hand not starting an electric arc when attacking a Skull on a wire
[*] Fixed Nocturna's minimap continuing to display the locations of enemies after transforming back into human form
[*] Fixed Nocturna being able to transmogrify her weapon and head slots infinitely while in Bat Form
[*] Fixed walls interrupting ice slides in Phasing Mode
[*] Fixed Dagger of Phasing being stopped by chests and shrines when thrown
[*] Fixed Pixie explosions not destroying items, wires, ice, water or metal doors
[*] Fixed Vaults containing gold when playing Monk and Coda
[*] Fixed the player's previous position not resetting when using a War Drum or other action items, affecting enemy movement
[*] Fixed the Conjurer's and Transmogrifier's price resetting to the minimum after generating enough items using Ring of Shadows
[*] Fixed Headless Skeletons, Cutlass parries, Ring of Pain, Boots of Lunging, Golden Lute and crate knockback treating diagonal damage as orthogonal
[*] Fixed Pixies not retaliating against players lunging into them with an Axe
[*] Fixed exploding Pixies damaging distant players wielding a Rapier
[*] Fixed some enemies moving immediately after taking knockback in Randomizer Mode, even if they were randomized to be slower
[*] Fixed Skeletons getting stuck in place when walking into a Rat Familiar
[*] Fixed Slimes being biased towards bumping into walls
[*] Fixed spellcasts being treated as movements in some cases, causing the player to start sliding on ice and Clones to move again
[*] Fixed Ghasts and Ghouls idling for one beat after moving into a Rat Familiar
[*] Fixed War Drum, Blood Drum, Boots of Leaping and Boots of Lunging causing level transitions to be delayed when used on a staircase
[*] Fixed unaffordable chests resetting Tempo's death timer
[/list]
[h1]General Changes for All Versions[/h1]

[h2]New Features and Additions[/h2]
[list]
[h3]Enemy outlines[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemy silhouettes now have a faint outline, making them easier to see against dark floor tiles.
[*] The intensity of this effect can be changed in the graphical options.
[*] Enemies standing in total darkness or within a Nightmare's shadow do not have outlines.
[/list]
[h3]Co-op target indicators[/h3]
[list]
[*] In co-op mode, enemies now indicate which player they are currently following via a small arrow pointing at the player.
[*] Whenever an enemy's target player changes, this arrow appears for a few seconds before fading out.
[*] The visibility of these indicators can be configured in the gameplay options.
[/list]
[h3]Local co-op adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Local co-op players now share their coin multipliers, gold counters and spell inventories.
[list]
[*] This also applies to Cadence and Dorian in Cadence's final boss fight in single-player.
[/list]
[*] Local co-op players always teleport together when entering or exiting a secret shop, while online co-op players can enter and leave separately.
[/list]
[h3]New International Font[/h3]
[list]
[*] Crypt of the NecroDancer now uses the [i]Silver[/i] pixel font to display international characters.
[*] The original vector font from previous versions can be enabled in the language options.
[/list]
[h3]Workshop mod extraction[/h3]
[list]
[*] The contents of resource packs downloaded from the Steam Workshop can now be explored by using the 'open directory' option in the mod browser.
[*] In order to use the modified resource pack, it must be copied from the <code>downloaded_mods</code> to <code>mods</code>.
[/list]
[h3]Level Editor Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] The enemy types spawned by Sarcophagi can now be customized
[*] The item dropped by Shopkeepers can now be customized
[*] Boss levels can now be resized freely
[*] Added a confirmation when trying to leave the level editor when there are unsaved changes
[*] Added a setting to mute the music in the level editor (enabled by default)
[*] Changed the Ghost Shopkeeper to no longer sing his soothing song while in the level editor
[/list]
[h3]Game Window Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Changed Vertical Sync to be controlled by a separate checkbox in the Display Options menu
[*] Changed the game window to open at the appropriate resolution immediately, instead of resizing shortly after launch[/list]

For the full patch notes, including a ton of bug fixes not listed here, head over to our [url=https://braceyourselfgames.com/2022/08/04/necrodancer-synchrony-dlc-available-now-v3-1-0/]website[/url]! For all the latest NecroDancer-related announcements and discussions be sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/utuuFkmY]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/NecroDancerGame]Twitter[/url]!

notes.title: Update v3.03
notes.content:
Crypt of the NecroDancer v3.0.3 is now available! We'd like to give a special thank you to community member Elyscape who provided extensive support for the MacOS ARM64 build. NecroDancer v3.0.3 should now run correctly on Apple M1 devices! 

[h2]New features and changes[/h2]

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added support for playing the Daily Challenge in co-op mode
[*] Added the ability to manually create a beatmap by tapping to the rhythm when importing custom music
[*] Added support for changing the skin of Mary's Lamb via workshop mods
[*] Added keyboard shortcut to open a dungeon in the level editor (defaults to Ctrl+O, can be remapped in the options)
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the minimap to display players as blinking blue pixels
[*] Changed the Conjurer's and Transmogrifier's price overflow behavior to be controlled by a quirk
[*] Changed Tempo's ability to get infinite countdown resets from an unaffordable chest to be controlled by a quirk
[/list]

[h2]General Bugfixes[/h2]

[h3]Stability[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed MacOS build not starting up on Apple Silicon devices when running in native ARM64 mode
[list] [*] Huge thanks to Elyscape for their help with this fix! [/list]
[/list]
[h3]Steam Workshop & Modding[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed custom music failing to be imported on Windows for users with special characters in their username
[*] Fixed some skins rendering incorrectly while standing on a wire
[*] Fixed Nocturna skins displaying her human head sprite in Bat Form
[*] Fixed modded character skins applying incorrectly when only the head spritesheet or only the body spritesheet is replaced
[/list]
[h3]Level Editor[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed shop floor not being available in the level editor
[*] Fixed level editor spawning additional characters in player-locked levels
[*] Fixed level editor prompting about unsaved changes when loading a dungeon, even if no unsaved changes are present
[*] Fixed Pre-Angered Pawnbroker being invincible when placed in the editor
[/list]
[h3]Input[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed certain keyboard keys being incorrectly recognized as alphabetical keys on Windows
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed goblin sentries repeatedly screaming when waking up while out of sight or frozen
[*] Fixed clones using the Cadence clone sprite, regardless of the character being played
[*] Fixed Hard Mode Sarcophagi sometimes spawning as lords
[*] Fixed Shop Wall Mimics leaving floating torches behind
[*] Fixed Sleeping Gargoyle Mimics not being killable by piercing damage
[*] Fixed Moles spawning on tar tiles

notes.title: Update v3.0.2
notes.content:
Crypt of the NecroDancer v3.0.2 is now available! Localizations return in this update,

[h2]New Features and Changes[/h2]

[h3]Localizations are back! Thanks for your patience while we worked on these.[/h3]
[list][*] Added automatic language detection based on Steam client preference
[*] Added translations for the following languages:
	[list] [*] German
	[*] French
	[*] Italian
	[*] Spanish
	[*] Japanese
	[*] Portuguese
	[*] Russian
	[*] Korean
	[*] Simplified Chinese
	[*] Traditional Chinese [/list][/list]
[h3]Translation Mods[/h3]
[list][*] Added option to create a new language mod with a translation template via the language selection menu
[*] Added support for loading translations from the Steam Workshop
[list][*] Translation CSV files should be placed in a `languages` subfolder inside the mod's root directory[/list]
[*] Added support for layering language modifications on top of existing translations
[list][*] For this to work, mods should name their translation files according to the language ISO-code (e.g. `languages/de_DE.csv`)
[*] Supported language codes are: `en_US`, `de_DE`, `fr_FR`, `it_IT`, `es_ES`, `ja_JP`, `pt_BR`, `ru_RU`, `ko_KR`, `zh_CN`, `zh_TW`
[*] In addition, if a mod provides a file called `languages/all.csv`, text strings can be injected across all languages [/list]
[*] Added support for overriding English strings in language mods (via `languages/en_US.csv`)
[*] Added support for overriding text strings across all languages in mods (via `languages/all.csv`)[/list]
[h3]Point Symmetric Co-op HUD Mode[/h3]
[list] [*] Player 2's HUD is mirrored horizontally and vertically, allowing the icons and text to be displayed at a larger scale
[*] This is enabled by default on the Steam Deck to improve readability[/list]
[h3]Skin Mods Support[/h3]
[list][*] Added an advanced setting to enable selecting skins for any character in the 'Change Skin' menu
[*] Added support for selecting non-AMPLIFIED character skins from mods while AMPLIFIED content is enabled
	[list][*] When standing on a wire, the character is displayed as normal instead of displaying an electricity effect
	[*] When Quartz or Heavy Glass armor is equipped, the character sprite is shown without the armor[/list][/list]
[h3]UI and HUD Additions[/h3]
[list][*] Added pause menu indicator and run introduction text to indicate that Custom Rules or `necrodancer.xml` mods are active
[*] Added compatibility with "Words to Arrows" and other workshop mods that tweak the key combo HUD text
[*] Added an option to show default HUD text for each input map to the 'Reassign controls' menu[/list]
[h3]Calibration Additions[/h3]
[list][*] Added auto-calibration for audio latency, increasing/decreasing effective latency to match early/late beats
[*] Added a grace period of 50 milliseconds immediately following a valid input
	[list] [*] During this time, missed beats are silently ignored instead of causing the coin multiplier to be lost [/list][/list]
[h3]Level Editor[/h3]
[list][*] Added the ability to quickly switch to the level editor's category list and dismiss searches by right clicking the object panel[/list]
[h3]New Launch Parameters for Steam Cloud and Native Controller Support[/h3]
[list][*] Added launch parameter `--no-steam-cloud` to disable Steam Cloud synchronization
[*] Added launch parameter `--no-steam-input` to disable Steam Input and enable native controller support
	[list] [*] This should restore compatibility with Dancepads and other input devices not recognized by Steam Input
	[*] Some controller models may use non-standard button layouts, requiring manual configuration via the 'Reassign controls' menu
	[*] In addition to passing this launch option, it may be required to disable Steam Input Integration in the properties of Crypt of the NecroDancer within the Steam library [/list][/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list] [*] Changed skin loader to automatically apply modded skins to all characters, instead of just the currently active character
[*] Changed level editor categorization to show wall torches in the same category as walls, instead of items
[*] Changed replay controls to reappear when pressing a valid hotkey while viewing a replay
[*] Changed controller auto-detection to more eagerly switch devices without having to use the 'Reassign Controls' menu
[*] Changed travel runes to automatically generate secret shops in the level editor when an odd number of runes is placed
[*] Changed the default multi-key combo delay from 50ms to 40ms to reduce the likelihood of late missed beats [/list]
[h2]General Bugfixes[/h2]
[h3]Stability[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed error during item generation when restoring very long deathless runs
[*] Fixed error when frame-perfectly pressing >4 keys at once while rebinding a key[/list]
[h3]Achievements & Leaderboards[/h3]

[h3]Steam Workshop & Modding[/h3]

[*] Fixed translation files failing to load if they contain CRLF line endings or a UTF-8 Byte Order Mark
[*] Fixed non-functioning 'Open directory' option being shown for packaged workshop mods[/list]
[h3]Input[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed unpause countdown and latency calibration click track being inaudible on low sound volumes[/list]
[h3]Level Editor[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed level editor sometimes turning unchanged levels into void levels when opening and saving a dungeon

notes.title: Update v3.0.1
notes.content:
Crypt of the NecroDancer v3.0.1 is now available! Before we get into the changelog, we wanted to take some of this space to address some of the most frequently asked questions so far.

[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[h3]Is this update coming to consoles?[/h3]
This update is currently just for PC, but we would like to bring it to other platforms eventually! Feature set TBD, because certain features like custom music and mods are hard to port.

[h3]I can't change the language from English in the new update! Help![/h3]
Because we switched to a text-based localization system in version 3.0.0, we're currently in the process of migrating all existing translations to this new system. We're going to re-add all previously supported languages in an upcoming patch. Until then, the Legacy Client (available as a Steam launch option) still allows you to play the game in supported languages!

[h3]How can I access No Beat Mode?[/h3]
[olist][*] Open the Menu
[*] Go to Custom Rules -- > Gameplay Options --> Extra Modes
[*] Change Rhythm: Regular --> Rhythm: No Beat Mode[/olist]
Now onto the patch notes!

[h2]New Features and Changes[/h2]
[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list][*] Added an option to delete all save data to the 'Gameplay Options' menu
[*] Added Steam Cloud synchronization for 'Save & Quit' states, progression and settings
[*] Added progress display when resuming saved sessions
[*] Added the ability to discard saved sessions while loading and return to the lobby instead
[*] Added warning message about achievements/leaderboards when trying to edit custom rules for the first time
[*] Added support for placing Gold, Blood and Diamond price tags in the level editor
[*] Added support for turning enemies into Lords in the level editor
[*] Added support for reducing the player's starting health in the level editor
[*] Added support for looping any song in the level editor[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list][*] Changed the timing window for multikey combos from 30 ms to 50 ms, making them much easier to hit
[*] Changed Steam Workshop integration to load mods directly, without first extracting them to `downloaded_mods`
[*] Changed the character skin selection menu to highlight the currently active skin
[*] Changed the character skin selection menu to list only skins from locally installed mods or active workshop mods
[list][*] For convenience, we've added a shortcut to open the mod browser from the character skin selection menu[/list]
[*] Changed Quick Restart hotkey to be inactive during All Characters, Story and Deathless runs past the first loop
[*] Changed the 'PixieRapier' quirk to enable more finegrained control over the interaction
[*]Changed mutliline text prompts to allow leaving them by pressing the *Down Arrow* key on the last line[/list]
[h2]General Bugfixes[/h2]
[h3]Performance & Stability[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed framerate drops when loading textures or updating the minimap
[*] Fixed framerate drops when a sound effect is played for the first time
[*] Fixed framerate drops when opening the 'Mods' menu for the first time in a session
[*] Fixed the Linux build not launching from Steam unless the Steam Linux Runtime is enabled
[*] Fixed a crash related to the Steam API failing to initialize
[*] Fixed intermittent game freezes caused by the 'Enable Performance Logging' advanced setting[/list]
[h3]Save & Quit[/h3]

[*] Fixed 'Save & Quit' causing active extra modes not to reset after returning to the lobby[/list]
[h3]Achievements & Leaderboards[/h3]

[*] Fixed Deathless leaderboards not being displayed correctly in the menu[/list]
[h3]Audio & Soundtrack[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed all characters starting on the DannyB soundtrack, instead of their respective default soundtracks

[*] Fixed soundtracks being listed in the wrong order in 'Change Soundtrack' menu

[*] Fixed 'Custom Music' menu failing to load files from paths with special characters
[*] Fixed character soundtrack settings not being imported from pre3.0 savefile
[*] Fixed 'Nicolas Daoust as Shopkeeper' setting not being imported from pre3.0 savefile
[*] Fixed Banshees screaming at an incorrect volume[/list]
[h3]Steam Workshop & Modding[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed mods and custom dungeons uploaded prior in 3.0.0 not being visible on the Steam Workshop

[list][*] The available set of characters can be controlled by adding an entry for `translation.fontVariant` to the CSV file
[*] Supported values are `JP` (default), `KR`, `SC` and `TC`[/list][/list]
[h3]Cutscenes[/h3]

notes.title: Rhythm roguelike Crypt of the Necrodancer gets massive update after 5-year hiatus
